title: Puck frame graph (puck.render.graph.v1)
description: A frame as a document: passes connected by named image and buffer versions, planned by the one pipeline planner (ShaderPipelineCompiler). Every view renders an instance of a graph, and a version declared External is an input the host binds, such as another instance's output. Its members are the pipeline document's members, with the same shapes, plus Packages: a puck.shader.pipeline.v1 document's content is a graph with no packages, so a pipeline is a graph a world names.

resources.description: The versions, as a pipeline declares them.

items.description: One resource version declared by a ShaderPipelineDefinition. Each version has exactly one writer. A version that names From forwards that predecessor: its writer continues the predecessor's storage and contents, so the predecessor is consumed and every pass that samples it runs before the overwrite.

format.description: The backend-neutral format spelling. Required for images and depth resources.

history.description: Retains this version's contents into the next frame, where a pass input reads them with PreviousFrame. Only the last version of a forwarding chain can be history, because a forward would overwrite what is retained.

initialization.description: How the first frame obtains valid contents. Only a version that forwards nothing declares it; a forwarded version's contents come from its predecessor.
initialization.title: ShaderPipelineInitialization

sizeBytes.description: A fixed buffer's capacity in bytes, a multiple of four and of StrideBytes, or null for an image or a counted buffer. A buffer without a stride is a raw buffer of 32-bit words, read and written by byte address.

from.description: The predecessor version this one forwards, or null for a version whose writer starts from discarded contents. A predecessor has at most one successor, and its kind, format, extent and sample count equal this version's.

samples.description: The sample count of an image. Only single-sampled images are executable, so any other count is refused by name.

strideBytes.description: A structured buffer's element stride in bytes, a positive multiple of four, or null for a raw buffer. Only a package pass reaches a structured buffer.

count.description: A counted buffer's size in elements, a sum of terms that each scale with a product of counts the host resolves, in place of SizeBytes. Only a package pass reaches a counted buffer.

items.description: One term of a counted buffer's size: Elements elements per unit of the product of the bases in Per, each element ElementBytes long. A buffer's count is the sum of its terms.

per.description: The bases whose units multiply, at least one, each at most once.

items.description: Identifies a count a term of a counted buffer's size scales with.
items.title: ShaderPipelineCountBasis

elements.description: The elements per unit of the product, at least one.

items.title: ShaderPipelineCountTerm
ShaderPipelineResource

outputs.description: The public versions; the first is what a consumer reads by default.

passes.description: The shader passes, as a pipeline declares them, or null for none.

items.description: One executable pass in a shader pipeline.

source.description: The HLSL source's path, relative to the pipeline document. A package's pass the planner orders carries its package id here.

entryPoint.description: The entry point compiled by the shader compiler: a compute pass's kernel, or a graphics pass's fragment stage. A package's pass compiles nothing and leaves it empty.

kind.description: Compute, fullscreen graphics, or indexed geometry. A document names no package work; the planner orders a package's pass (ShaderPipelinePackagePass) in the compute shape it reaches resources by, and its planned pass carries Package.
kind.title: ShaderPipelineDocumentPassKind

inputs.description: Named resource bindings. Set PreviousFrame explicitly for feedback.

items.description: A pass's reference to one resource version: which version it reads or writes, which frame's instance, and its descriptor binding.

previousFrame.description: Reads the contents the previous frame left rather than this frame's. Only a pass input sets it, and only for a version declared History.

binding.description: The descriptor binding, or null for the planner to assign one.

items.title: ResourceReference

outputs.description: The versions the pass writes. A graphics pass writes one color image and, for a geometry pass, at most one depth version.

config.description: Optional config fields, using the shared shader-set config vocabulary.

additionalProperties.description: One field of a ShaderSetManifest's config schema — what a document may author for this shader set, validated by TryBindConfig and emitted as JSON Schema by ConfigJsonSchema.

type.description: The value type; a document value is a number for a scalar type and an array of ComponentCount numbers for a vector type.
type.title: ShaderValueType

default.description: The value an absent document field resolves to, or null when the field is required.
default.$comment: Open payload: this member's shape is decided by an id named elsewhere in the document, never by this generator.

min.description: The inclusive per-component minimum, or null for none.

max.description: The inclusive per-component maximum, or null for none.

description.description: The field's description, carried into the emitted JSON Schema.

additionalProperties.title: ShaderConfigField

groupSizeX.description: Compute workgroup width; ignored for graphics passes.

groupSizeY.description: Compute workgroup height; ignored for graphics passes.

groupSizeZ.description: Compute workgroup depth; ignored for graphics passes.

vertex.description: How a fullscreen pass's vertex stage obtains the triangle's corners; null means VertexId. Only a fullscreen pass declares it.
vertex.title: ShaderPipelineVertexInput

geometry.description: A geometry pass's vertices, indices and vertex layout. Only a geometry pass declares it, and it must.

vertexEntryPoint.description: The vertex stage's entry point in the pass's source, which also holds the fragment stage's EntryPoint. The vertex stage receives no parameters: the pass's parameter block reaches only the fragment stage.

strideBytes.description: The bytes of one vertex, a positive multiple of four.

attributes.description: The vertex attributes, one per location from zero.

items.description: One attribute of a geometry pass's vertices. The vertex stage reads attribute n as the POSITION{n} semantic, the nth input it declares.

location.description: The attribute's input location, equal to its position in the attribute list.

format.description: The attribute's format, spelled as a GpuVertexFormat name.

offsetBytes.description: The attribute's byte offset within one vertex, a multiple of four.

items.title: ShaderPipelineVertexAttribute

vertices.description: The vertex data as 32-bit floats, a whole number of vertices.

indices.description: The triangle list's indices, three per triangle, each naming a declared vertex.

indexFormat.description: The width of each index; a 16-bit index is at most 65535.
indexFormat.title: ShaderPipelineIndexFormat

geometry.title: ShaderPipelineGeometry

depthCompare.description: A geometry pass's depth test, which it declares exactly when it writes a depth version; null there means Less. A passing fragment writes its depth.
depthCompare.title: ShaderPipelineDepthCompare

blend.description: A graphics pass's blend policy; null means Opaque, the only policy the planner admits.
blend.title: ShaderPipelineBlend

alphaTest.description: An alpha-test cutoff. The planner refuses every value by name.

dispatch.description: A compute or package pass's dispatch shape; null means Extent. A graphics pass declares none.

groupCountX.description: A Groups dispatch's group count in x, otherwise one.

groupCountY.description: A Groups dispatch's group count in y, otherwise one.

groupCountZ.description: A Groups dispatch's group count in z, otherwise one.

arguments.description: An Indirect dispatch's buffer version, which the pass reaches in the indirect-argument state and names in neither its inputs nor its outputs; otherwise null.

argumentsOffsetBytes.description: The byte offset of the three group-count words in Arguments, a multiple of four.

dispatch.title: ShaderPipelineDispatch

items.title: ShaderPipelinePass

packages.description: The engine-package passes, or null for none.

items.description: One pass of engine work a graph names by package instead of by shader source: SDF rendering, the overlay, or a shipped post-process set. The package decides how it records its work; the graph decides which versions it reads and writes, and the planner orders it among the shader passes by those versions.

name.description: The pass's unique name, shared with the shader passes.

package.description: The package id, which the host's RenderGraphPackageCatalog declares.

inputs.description: The versions the package reads, one per input port in port order. A reference may read a history version's previous frame. A package binds its own descriptors, so no reference declares a binding.

outputs.description: The image versions the package writes, one per output port in port order.

items.title: RenderGraphPackagePass
